structured_content.summary:
The deadline is enforced only at the scout level: `ScoutEngine::scout` wraps the whole inner run in `tokio::time::timeout`. On expiry it drops the entire batch future and returns an empty result with a timeout summary, zero turn/tool counts, and elapsed duration. This loses completed sibling results and does not expose a consistent failure field. [crates/core/src/engine.rs:35](crates/core/src/engine.rs:35)

Batches are launched by `RepoTools::call_many`, which delegates to `execute_tools`. That function fills up to `concurrency` slots, runs each executor call under an individual timeout, awaits whichever sibling finishes next, and stores results by original index. Per-tool timeout results are marked failed with fixed timeout duration metadata. [crates/repo-tools/src/lib.rs:103](crates/repo-tools/src/lib.rs:103) [crates/repo-tools/src/exec.rs:17](crates/repo-tools/src/exec.rs:17)

The implementation change belongs primarily in `crates/repo-tools/src/exec.rs`: give the batch loop an absolute deadline, use deadline-aware selection while awaiting siblings, retain results already received, cancel/drop remaining in-flight futures at expiry, and synthesize deadline failures with measured duration. Preserve the existing result shape (`failed`, `duration_ms`) defined in `types.rs`. [crates/repo-tools/src/types.rs:30](crates/repo-tools/src/types.rs:30)

Then change `crates/core/src/engine.rs` so the deadline path consumes/returns the batch’s partial results and constructs the same failure/duration metadata rather than replacing all progress with zeroed stats. Tests should be added beside the existing concurrency test in `exec.rs`: one completed sibling plus one blocked sibling must return promptly, preserve the completed result, cancel the blocked executor/subprocess, and mark the deadline result failed with duration; an engine-level timeout test should verify partial tool-call counts and nonzero elapsed duration. The current test only verifies parallel speed/order and has no cancellation or deadline assertions. [crates/repo-tools/src/exec.rs:65](crates/repo-tools/src/exec.rs:65)
